description: Land Acquisition - Gonapeenuwala, Gonapeenuwala D/S Division, Galle District and 3 other notices in D/S D's Galle Four Gravets, Natthandiya and Hakmana
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke) exercising powers, the core content is about land matters rather than government structure or personnel changes. The document is explicitly labeled "PART III - LANDS" and contains multiple orders for taking possession of specific land parcels with detailed property descriptions.
